What is covered in my Oral-B warranty?
Your Oral-B warranty starts on the day of purchase and runs for 2 years. If your Oral-B product is defective during the warranty period, we will replace it free of charge*.
The warranty does not cover cosmetic damage such as scratches, or damage caused by:
Normal wear and tear
Accident, misuse, dirt or water
The product being tampered with
Improper use
Repairs carried out by agents not authorized by Oral-B/Braun
Failure to take proper care of the product, including recharging
The product being altered or used for commercial purposes
How can I get my Oral-B electric toothbrush serviced?
If you’re experiencing a problem with your Oral-B toothbrush, check out our Online Repair Service! There you’ll find troubleshooting tips which may help resolve the issue. Simply go to
www.service.oralb.com
, select your Region, Country and Language and then click on the "Online Check" button.
If you’re unable to fix the problem and need to send your toothbrush for service, you can use the online service to print off a pre-paid mailing label and get a tracking number. The tracking number will enable you to track the progress of your request.
Please note you must have a receipt that includes date of purchase to get a pre-paid mailing label and your brush must be within its warranty period.
If you’re unable to use the Online Repair Service, please see the instructions below.
For In Warranty service, follow these simple steps:
Visit
www.service.oralb.com
to find details of your closest Oral-B Authorized Service Center.
Send the product directly to the Service Center, including:
All system components (e.g., toothbrush handle, charger, power cord, SmartGuide). You do not need to include accessories like the brush heads or refill stand.
A copy of your dated proof of purchase (always keep a copy for yourself).
A letter including the following information: your name, return mailing address, contact phone number, e-mail address and a brief explanation of the problem you're experiencing with the product.
If you include your e-mail address, the Oral-B Service center will send you updates when the product is received and when product is shipped back, along with a tracking number.
All products sent in for service must be well packaged and sent in a box suitable to withstand normal freight handling. It is recommended that your package is appropriately insured and shipped using a carrier who can provide tracking. We will cover all repair costs and return shipping to you.
For Out of Warranty service: You can still send your device to an Oral-B Authorized Service Center for service at your own cost. If the product warranty has expired, a quote will be sent to you for approval and payment, prior to any service. Before shipping your device, we recommend you call the authorized Service Center to discuss your service needs.

Oral-B iO Series 5 Electric Toothbrush FAQs
How do I turn off the Oral-B iO Series 5 electric toothbrush?
To turn off your Oral-B iO Series 5, follow these simple steps:
Locate the power button on the handle.
Press the power button until the display and any indicator lights go off. This signals that the device is powered down.
Keep in mind that if you leave your brush idle for a period of time, it may also automatically shut off to conserve battery life.
What is the Oral-B iO 5 good for?
The Oral-B iO 5 is a smart electric toothbrush designed to elevate your daily oral care routine. Here are some key benefits and features that make it stand out:
Advanced Cleaning Action: Combining oscillating, rotating, and micro-vibrating movements, the iO 5 is engineered to remove plaque effectively from tooth surfaces and along the gumline.
Interactive Guidance: With its built-in interactive display and Bluetooth connectivity, the iO 5 provides real-time feedback on your brushing habits. It offers guidance on brushing duration, pressure, and technique, helping you improve and maintain proper oral hygiene.
Multiple Cleaning Modes: The toothbrush offers various modes (such as Daily Clean, Gum Care, and more) tailored to different needs, whether you’re looking for a gentle clean, intensive plaque removal, or specific gum care.
User-Friendly Design: The intuitive controls and sleek design of the iO 5 make it easy to use for anyone. Features like the timer and pressure sensor help promote best practices to prevent overbrushing and ensure a balanced clean across all areas.
Enhanced Gum Health: Its cleaning technology not only targets plaque but also promotes healthier gums by gently stimulating and massaging the gum tissue, which can be beneficial for those with sensitive gums or at risk for gingivitis.
How many brushing modes are available on the Oral-B iO Series 5 handle?
There are 5 Smart Brushing Modes on the iO 5: Daily Clean for everyday healthy teeth and gums, Intense Clean for tough-to-remove stains, Sensitive for people with mild tooth sensitivity, Super Sensitive for those with greater teeth sensitivity, and Whitening to make your teeth extra bright.
Does the Oral-B iO Series 5 have a pressure sensor?
Yes. The Oral-B's iO’s smart pressure sensor signals if you brush too hard, too soft, or just right for an effective and safe clean while protecting your gums.
How long does the Oral-B iO 5 battery last?
The Oral-B iO 5 has a long-lasting lithium-ion battery designed for extended use between charges. It also has a low-charge indicator, so you’ll know when it’s time to recharge.
Does the Oral-B iO Series 5 handle vibrate when it's time to switch quadrants?
Yes, the Oral-B iO Series 5 handle vibrates every 30 seconds to let you know when to switch cleaning surfaces during the dentist-recommended 2-minute brushing time.
How does the Oral-B iO Series 5 pressure sensor signal if I am brushing too lightly?
The Oral-B iO Series 5 pressure sensor signals if you brush too hard, too soft, or just right, helping guide you to the right pressure for an effective clean.

sections.heading: How do I turn off the Oral-B iO Series 5 electric toothbrush?
sections.text:
To turn off your Oral-B iO Series 5, follow these simple steps:
Locate the power button on the handle.
Press the power button until the display and any indicator lights go off. This signals that the device is powered down.
Keep in mind that if you leave your brush idle for a period of time, it may also automatically shut off to conserve battery life.

sections.heading: What is the Oral-B iO 5 good for?
sections.text:
The Oral-B iO 5 is a smart electric toothbrush designed to elevate your daily oral care routine. Here are some key benefits and features that make it stand out:
Advanced Cleaning Action: Combining oscillating, rotating, and micro-vibrating movements, the iO 5 is engineered to remove plaque effectively from tooth surfaces and along the gumline.
Interactive Guidance: With its built-in interactive display and Bluetooth connectivity, the iO 5 provides real-time feedback on your brushing habits. It offers guidance on brushing duration, pressure, and technique, helping you improve and maintain proper oral hygiene.
Multiple Cleaning Modes: The toothbrush offers various modes (such as Daily Clean, Gum Care, and more) tailored to different needs, whether you’re looking for a gentle clean, intensive plaque removal, or specific gum care.
User-Friendly Design: The intuitive controls and sleek design of the iO 5 make it easy to use for anyone. Features like the timer and pressure sensor help promote best practices to prevent overbrushing and ensure a balanced clean across all areas.
Enhanced Gum Health: Its cleaning technology not only targets plaque but also promotes healthier gums by gently stimulating and massaging the gum tissue, which can be beneficial for those with sensitive gums or at risk for gingivitis.

sections.heading: How many brushing modes are available on the Oral-B iO Series 5 handle?
sections.text: There are 5 Smart Brushing Modes on the iO 5: Daily Clean for everyday healthy teeth and gums, Intense Clean for tough-to-remove stains, Sensitive for people with mild tooth sensitivity, Super Sensitive for those with greater teeth sensitivity, and Whitening to make your teeth extra bright.

sections.heading: Does the Oral-B iO Series 5 have a pressure sensor?
sections.text: Yes. The Oral-B's iO’s smart pressure sensor signals if you brush too hard, too soft, or just right for an effective and safe clean while protecting your gums.

sections.heading: How long does the Oral-B iO 5 battery last?
sections.text: The Oral-B iO 5 has a long-lasting lithium-ion battery designed for extended use between charges. It also has a low-charge indicator, so you’ll know when it’s time to recharge.

sections.heading: Does the Oral-B iO Series 5 handle vibrate when it's time to switch quadrants?
sections.text: Yes, the Oral-B iO Series 5 handle vibrates every 30 seconds to let you know when to switch cleaning surfaces during the dentist-recommended 2-minute brushing time.

sections.heading: How does the Oral-B iO Series 5 pressure sensor signal if I am brushing too lightly?
sections.text:
The Oral-B iO Series 5 pressure sensor signals if you brush too hard, too soft, or just right, helping guide you to the right pressure for an effective clean.

sections.heading: Warranty information
sections.text:
What is covered in my Oral-B warranty?
Your Oral-B warranty starts on the day of purchase and runs for 2 years. If your Oral-B product is defective during the warranty period, we will replace it free of charge*.
The warranty does not cover cosmetic damage such as scratches, or damage caused by:
Normal wear and tear
Accident, misuse, dirt or water
The product being tampered with
Improper use
Repairs carried out by agents not authorized by Oral-B/Braun
Failure to take proper care of the product, including recharging
The product being altered or used for commercial purposes
How can I get my Oral-B electric toothbrush serviced?
If you’re experiencing a problem with your Oral-B toothbrush, check out our Online Repair Service! There you’ll find troubleshooting tips which may help resolve the issue. Simply go to www.service.oralb.com , select your Region, Country and Language and then click on the "Online Check" button.
If you’re unable to fix the problem and need to send your toothbrush for service, you can use the online service to print off a pre-paid mailing label and get a tracking number. The tracking number will enable you to track the progress of your request. Please note you must have a receipt that includes date of purchase to get a pre-paid mailing label and your brush must be within its warranty period.
If you’re unable to use the Online Repair Service, please see the instructions below.
For In Warranty service, follow these simple steps:
Visit www.service.oralb.com to find details of your closest Oral-B Authorized Service Center.
Send the product directly to the Service Center, including:
All system components (e.g., toothbrush handle, charger, power cord, SmartGuide). You do not need to include accessories like the brush heads or refill stand.
A copy of your dated proof of purchase (always keep a copy for yourself).
A letter including the following information: your name, return mailing address, contact phone number, e-mail address and a brief explanation of the problem you're experiencing with the product.
If you include your e-mail address, the Oral-B Service center will send you updates when the product is received and when product is shipped back, along with a tracking number.
All products sent in for service must be well packaged and sent in a box suitable to withstand normal freight handling. It is recommended that your package is appropriately insured and shipped using a carrier who can provide tracking. We will cover all repair costs and return shipping to you.
For Out of Warranty service: You can still send your device to an Oral-B Authorized Service Center for service at your own cost. If the product warranty has expired, a quote will be sent to you for approval and payment, prior to any service. Before shipping your device, we recommend you call the authorized Service Center to discuss your service needs.
